load_mujoco_physics_from_xml: load a MuJoCo physics model from an XML file path using Physics.from_xml_path
step_physics_simulation: step the MuJoCo physics simulation forward by n steps using Physics.step
render_mujoco_camera_view: render an RGB or depth image from a MuJoCo camera using Physics.render or Camera.render
get_physics_state: get or set the full physics simulation state using Physics.get_state and Physics.set_state
create_action_spec: create a BoundedArraySpec for MuJoCo actuator controls using the action_spec function
